note: Mongolia: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 90, 30, 21 or 14 days (many of the 30-day exemptions a temporary policy to 1 January 2027); Indians, Kuwaitis and Qataris may take a visa on arrival at Chinggis Khaan airport for 30 days; nationals on the e-Visa list apply online, taken here for every other passport (its exclusions aren't in the source read). Ukrainians' 90 days with a voucher aren't modelled. Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.said: Citizens of the following countries and territories may enter Mongolia without a visa for the following period: 90 days Argentina Belarus Brazil Chile Colombia Ecuador Kazakhstan Kyrgyzstan Macau Paraguay Peru South Korea United States 30 days All European Union member states Australia Canada Cuba Iceland Israel Japan Laos Liechtenstein Malaysia Maldives Monaco New Zealand Norway Russia Singapore Switzerland Thailand Turkey United Arab Emirates United Kingdom Uruguay Uzbekistan Vietnam 21 days Philippines 14 days Hong Kong T1 - Temporary visa-free policy available until 1 January 2027 ... Citizens of following countries traveling as tourists may obtain a visa on arrival at Chinggis Khaan International Airport for a maximum stay of 30 days. ... India Kuwait Qatar ...
